# GhostShell

> Seven free, open-source projects for hardware you own: Blu-ray and DVD
> authoring, Xbox 360, PS3 and PSP game management, PS3 disc decryption, a
> local browser bridge for CLI agents, and a live stream recorder.

Site: https://ghostyshell.github.io/

## Projects

- Keepsake Atelier - https://ghostyshell.github.io/keepsake-atelier/ - rip, author,
  verify and burn discs with native tooling; AACS key recovery, UDF 2.50 images,
  BD-J menus, 1:1 clones, MCP server. macOS, Linux, Windows. MIT.
- GODsend 360 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/GODSend-360/ - Xbox 360 game manager
  for Aurora: Minerva Archive and Internet Archive browsing, pure-Go ISO to GOD,
  DLC, title updates, save backups and an RXEA asset editor over FTP.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PSP - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-psp/ - PSP memory stick manager
  over USB: game and homebrew library with cover art, ffmpeg media conversion,
  ISO and CSO images, saves and mods. Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PS3 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-ps3/ - manage a CFW or HEN
  PlayStation 3 over FTP: library with cover art, virtual DualShock pad, game and
  homebrew downloads, ISO and split conversions, loopback MCP server.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- Browser Bridge - https://ghostyshell.github.io/browser-bridge/ - drives your real
  Chromium profile from any CLI agent through an extension and a loopback daemon.
  TypeScript. MIT.
- PS3 Quick Disc Decryptor - https://ghostyshell.github.io/ps3-qdd-mac/ - native
  macOS app that decrypts Redump PS3 images for RPCS3, no dependencies.
  Swift. GPL-3.0.
- stripchat-record - https://ghostyshell.github.io/stripchat-record/ - headless
  WebRTC recorder for Stripchat live streams at source resolution. Python. 18+.

All projects are free, need no account, and have no subscription.
